svg.text: Dittofeed: user deletion that stays deleted
Deleting a user removes their events and assignments, but work already in flight (a computation, a late event, a journey waiting at a delay) can bring the user back or
still message them. The agent fences every one of these paths in the TypeScript API and worker.
ingest routes and the two delete routes
compute: reads u, assignment write held
record the deletion watermark, then return
held write released after the delete
late batch, timestamp before the delete
u's journey wakes from its delay: message step recorded
a fresh u with only the new traits
The erased user drops out of the listing within 10 seconds of the delete and stays out for at least 60 seconds; other users and the same id in another workspace are untouched.
in-flight work arrives after the delete
